title: TickerInput
description: Fields available on each ticker object passed to stock agents. Enrichment fields are populated before the pipeline runs and are optional (may be absent if enrichment failed).

symbol.description: Ticker symbol — same as name, present after enrichment.

candle_frequency.description: yfinance interval used to fetch candles (e.g. '1d', '1h', '30m').

candle_count.description: Number of OHLCV candles fetched for this ticker.

enrichment_status.description: Whether enrichment succeeded. If 'failed', all indicator fields below will be absent.

ema.description: Exponential Moving Averages of closing price at multiple lengths, for the given candle timeframe.

ema_9.description: 9-period Exponential Moving Average of closing price.

ema_20.description: 20-period Exponential Moving Average of closing price.

ema_50.description: 50-period Exponential Moving Average of closing price.

ema_200.description: 200-period Exponential Moving Average of closing price.

timeframe.description: Candle interval the EMAs were computed on (e.g. '1d', '1h', '30m').

rsi_14.description: 14-period Relative Strength Index. Range: 0–100. Above 70 = overbought, below 30 = oversold.

atr.description: Average True Range, expressed as a percentage of the current price, for the given period and candle timeframe. Measures volatility.

value.description: ATR as a percentage of the current price, formatted with a trailing '%' (e.g. '4.11%').

period.description: Number of periods the ATR was computed over.

timeframe.description: Candle interval the ATR was computed on (e.g. '1d', '1h', '30m').

prev_day_high.description: Previous trading day's intraday high price.

prev_day_low.description: Previous trading day's intraday low price.

volume.description: Previous trading day's total volume (number of shares traded).

fifty_two_week_high.description: Highest intraday price over the last 252 trading days (~1 year).

fifty_two_week_low.description: Lowest intraday price over the last 252 trading days (~1 year).

vwap_prev_session.description: Volume-Weighted Average Price for the previous completed trading session.

volume_profile.description: Volume Profile over the last 252 trading days (~1 year). Shows price levels where the most trading activity occurred.

poc.description: Point of Control — price level with the highest traded volume.

vah.description: Value Area High — upper boundary of the price range containing 70% of volume.

val.description: Value Area Low — lower boundary of the price range containing 70% of volume.

lookback_sessions.description: Number of trading sessions the volume profile was computed over.

avg_daily_volume_20d.description: Average daily trading volume over the last 20 trading days. Formatted with a B/M suffix for readability (e.g. '2.16M'); left as a plain number if under 1,000,000.

benchmark.description: Snapshot of the benchmark index (e.g. SPY), shared across all tickers in the run — useful for relative-strength comparisons.

pre_market_change_pct.description: Benchmark's pre-market percentage change from previous close, formatted with a trailing '%' (e.g. '-7.58%').

market_cap.description: Market capitalisation in USD. Formatted with a B/M suffix for readability (e.g. '2.16B'); left as a plain number if under 1,000,000.

shares_outstanding.description: Total number of shares currently held by all shareholders. Formatted with a B/M suffix for readability (e.g. '115.35M'); left as a plain number if under 1,000,000.

beta.description: Measure of the stock's volatility relative to the overall market (1.0 = moves with the market; >1.0 = more volatile).

timeframe.description: Lookback window and sampling interval the beta was computed over (e.g. '1Y monthly').

next_earnings_date.description: Date of the company's next scheduled earnings report, ISO format (e.g. '2026-07-27'). May be an estimate.

pre_market_price.description: Current pre-market price (real-time via Finnhub, or 15-min delayed via yfinance). Null during regular/after-hours if no pre-market activity.

pre_market_change.description: Absolute price change from previous close during pre-market session.

pre_market_change_pct.description: Percentage price change from previous close during pre-market session.

pre_market_volume.description: Total volume traded during the pre-market session so far. Only populated when using Finnhub streaming.
